title: Pentagon says its Chief Digital and AI Office reached full operating capacity
summary: The Defense Department announced on 1 June that the CDAO office is fully operational, with Craig Martell as its head.

title: California regulator lets Cruise charge fares for driverless robotaxi rides in San Francisco
summary: The California Public Utilities Commission issued Cruise the state's first Driverless Deployment Permit.

title: YouTuber Yannic Kilcher runs a 4chan-trained language-model bot posting about 30,000 times; critics call it unethical
summary: The Verge reports Kilcher fine-tuned an open-source model on 4chan posts and ran bots for two 24-hour periods.

title: Google engineer says its LaMDA chatbot is sentient; Google says evidence does not support it and suspends him
summary: Sopitas reports Google suspended the engineer for a confidentiality breach after he made the consciousness claim.

title: Canada starts the second phase of its Pan-Canadian Artificial Intelligence Strategy
summary: Wikipedia's regulation-of-AI page records the launch of the second phase in June 2022.

title: Google researchers present Minerva, a PaLM-based model fine-tuned on science and maths text to solve quantitative problems
summary: Minerva breaks problems into steps and picks the most frequent generated solution.

title: UK Ministry of Defence publishes its Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy
summary: The strategy sets four objectives for making the military's use of AI effective and trusted.

title: Pentagon deputy secretary Hicks signs Responsible AI Strategy and Implementation Pathway
summary: The document, signed on 21 June, sets out how the Defense Department will implement responsible AI.

title: Yandex releases YaLM 100B, a 100-billion-parameter text model, as open source
summary: Yandex published the model on GitHub under the Apache 2.0 licence.

title: Spain and the European Commission present a pilot for the EU's first AI regulatory sandbox
summary: The Spanish digitalisation secretariat and the Commission presented the pilot at an event in Brussels.

title: Nearly twenty Cruise driverless cars cluster at a San Francisco intersection and block traffic for about two hours
summary: SFGate reports the cluster at Gough and Fulton on 29 June.

title: Samsung announces first mass production of chips on a 3 nm gate-all-around process
summary: Samsung says the process cuts power use by up to 45% and raises performance by 23% versus 5 nm.
